verdict.rationale: DBOS has no built-in natural-language interface. It does document an official MCP server that lets an external LLM or agent analyze and manage DBOS workflows, so users can operate workflows conversationally through a third-party AI client. The evidence is a single doc statement with no detail on which operations work this way. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of which management operations can be driven through the MCP tools, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation in practice.
